case_facts: A refrigerator I bought caught fire within a week from a manufacturing defect, damaging my kitchen; the company refuses to compensate me.

analysis.summary: A consumer purchased a refrigerator that caught fire within one week of purchase due to an alleged manufacturing defect, causing damage to the kitchen. The manufacturer has refused to provide any compensation for the product defect or the consequential property damage. The consumer seeks legal remedy for defective goods and resulting losses.

issues.issue: Whether the refrigerator constitutes 'defective goods' due to a manufacturing defect causing fire
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 2(10) – Definition of Defect; Section 84 – Liability of Product Manufacturer

issues.issue: Whether the manufacturer is liable under product liability for physical and property damage caused by the defective product
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Chapter VI – Product Liability, Sections 82-87

issues.issue: Whether the consumer is entitled to compensation for consequential property damage (kitchen damage) arising from the defective product
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 39 – Reliefs available; Section 86 – Liability of product service provider

issues.issue: Whether the manufacturer's refusal to compensate amounts to a deficiency in service or unfair trade practice
issues.governing_law: Consumer Protection Act 2019, Section 2(11) – Deficiency; Section 2(47) – Unfair Trade Practice

plan.esql: FROM legal-judgments | WHERE text LIKE '*manufacturing defect*' OR text LIKE '*product liability*' OR text LIKE '*defective goods*' OR text LIKE '*Consumer Protection Act*' | WHERE text LIKE '*refrigerator*' OR text LIKE '*appliance*' OR text LIKE '*fire*' OR text LIKE '*property damage*' | KEEP title, headline, catchwords, text | LIMIT 10
plan.search_rationale: The query targets judgments involving product liability, manufacturing defects in consumer appliances, and compensation for consequential property damage under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, using multi_match across key text fields and term boosts on critical legal doctrines to surface the most relevant precedents from consumer dispute forums and higher courts.
